Alex (Finance): FYI — Acme Health invoice `INV-2026-0789` charged full platform fee for Jan–Mar even though they scaled down dedicated pool mid-Feb. Contract `CT-ACME-452` includes proration language. Need reconcile before renewal.

Nina (Accounting): Noted. Invoice shows $42,000 platform fee; expected proration puts it around $28,500. Did billing run the full-quarter charge by mistake? :thinking:

OpsBot: Billing workflow: auto-charge completed 2026-05-12 03:12Z for INV-2026-0789. Charge ID `CHG-99a7`.

Jordan (CS): Customer confirmed reduction on 2026-02-15 in ticket #CS-9987. I can share the CS notes and the usage link: <https://redwood.app/customers/acme/usage|acme usage>.

Alex (Finance): Can someone pull raw meter logs for the dedicated pool 2026-01-01 → 2026-03-31? Need GPU-hours, reserved instance flags, and any automated proration toggles.

Nina (Accounting): I'll pull them now. Also flag: invoice lists support tier as "Enterprise" but contract shows "Pro" — that's an extra $6k on the invoice. We'll need to credit that if confirmed.

Leah (RevOps): If the proration and support tier are both wrong, we'll likely be issuing a credit memo. Anything > $20k needs Exec approval, fyi.

Alex (Finance): Rough estimate based on quick calc is ~ $15.5k credit (platform proration + support tier delta). Tagging @Leah for approval path. Also check the true-up clause — they had a committed throughput for Q1 that may affect the final number.

Jordan (CS): I can get the customer's written confirmation that they want a credit applied to next invoice instead of a refund. They're sensitive to cash flow.

Nina (Accounting): Pulled preliminary CSV (snippet):
```
customer,gpu_hours,reserved_flag,period
acme,4200,true,2026-01
acme,2600,true,2026-02-01_to_2026-02-14
acme,800,false,2026-02-15_to_2026-02-28
acme,1500,false,2026-03
```
Looks like Feb usage drops ~60% after 2026-02-15. Proration definitely applies.

OpsBot: Audit note: Invoice INV-2026-0789 flagged for manual review by finance at 2026-05-12T03:20Z.

Leah (RevOps): Provisional approval: authorize issuing a credit memo up to $20k pending final reconciled numbers and Legal sign-off on the support-tier amendment. Please route credit via `billing@redwood.com` and cc me.

Alex (Finance): Thanks. Nina — can you prepare a reconciliation table and a draft credit memo? Jordan — please confirm with Acme that they accept credit applied to next invoice and that they'll sign an amendment to set support tier to Pro going forward. Target to resolve before renewal on 2026-06-30.

Jordan (CS): Will do. Customer prefers credit applied to next invoice and wants the support tier change effective immediately once amendment is signed. I'll ask them to countersign.

Nina (Accounting): Draft credit memo in progress — will include: invoice number, charged amount, prorated platform fee adjustment, support tier delta, and proposed application (credit to next invoice). Sending draft by EOD 2026-05-13.

Alex (Finance): Hold final refund until Legal confirms amendment wording. Can someone ping Legal (not on this thread) to expedite?

Leah (RevOps): :thumbsup: I'll escalate to Legal and Ops. Keep me posted on the final reconciled total so I can sign off.

Jordan (CS): I'll attach the customer's acceptance and the signed amendment in this thread once received.

Nina (Accounting): Final question — do we need to run a retrospective true-up for committed throughput? Contract Section `3.5 (True-ups)` might require it. I'll include that calc in the reconciliation.

Alex (Finance): Good catch. Include any committed-vs-actual penalty/true-up in the memo line items.

Leah (RevOps): OK — provisional plan: 1) Reconcile meters & support tier 2) Draft credit memo (billing) 3) Customer sign amendment 4) Legal review 5) Apply credit to next invoice. Aim to close by 2026-06-01.

Jordan (CS): On it.

Nina (Accounting): Draft sent to Alex + Leah at 17:45 2026-05-13.

Alex (Finance): Received. Will queue for Legal. Thanks team.
